questions.solution_en:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 6.17.

 \(\sqrt{36+2}\)

a = 36, b = 2

Square root = \(\sqrt a + \frac{b}{2\sqrt a}\) 

= \(\sqrt {36} + \frac{2}{2\sqrt {36}}\)

= 6 + 1/6

= 6.17
